critique: The rig works: full-frame coverage with no empty band, clear upward displacement of trackable motifs between t1 and t4 (~360px, matching 120px/s), and the mirror-tile joins show no tear. But the CONTENT misses '简单几何图案' — soft cloudy noise upscaled 125% reads mushy/organic, not crisp geometry.

suggestions.why: Block noise type = hard-edged cells -> geometric pattern
high contrast for crisp two-tone shapes
smaller scale = readable repeating blocks instead of large blurs
